name: Quess Corp Limited
remarksWeb: 1. NRI Non-Repatriation 6,92,578 shares and NRI Repatriation 8,37,717 shares.   2. IDBI Trusteeship Services Ltd is the trustee of Thomas Cook India Limited Employees Trust and Thomas Cook India Limited is the settlor of the Trust.   3. With respect to the 4074 shares held in the unclaimed suspense account, are the outstanding shares of the shareholders of Thomas Cook (India) Limited (TCIL) held in the unclaimed suspense account, which were allotted at the time of the demerger of TCIL as per the entitlement ratio under the Scheme. It does not belong to TCIL. The shareholding of TCIL is Zero as on date and also as on June 30, 2026.  4. During the quarter ended 30.06.2026, the employees have been allotted RSUs based on their exercises.  5. Recategorisation of shareholding of Mr. Lohit Bhatia from KMP to Director and their Relatives (excluding Independent Directors and Nominee Directors) as a result of redesignation from Chief Executive Officer to Executive Director and Group CEO w.e.f June 01, 2026. Further, Mr. Guruprasad Srinivasan ceased to be the Executive Director of the Company. Hence, his shareholding, along with that of his immediate relative, has been recategorised under the Public category.
